Body.Content:
Timeseries insights will be retired on March 31st, 2025. Customers were guided to transition to Azure Data Explorer (ADX). To further accelerate the transition, we upgraded the former Timeseries insights client visualization component to work on Azure Data Explorer. That is why we released Kusto Trender, a JavaScript client for Kusto (Azure Data Explorer, Synapse Data Explorer, Kusto free), featuring components for making calls directly to Kusto, rendering results from the API, and more.

The code is available on GitHub under the MIT license. Samples can be accessed via the Kusto Trender Samples Gallery. Further details can be found on the Azure Data Explorer blog.
